newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong firms increase investment in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong firms increase investment in Shenzhen.

text.p: Hong Kong firms pumped $800 million in new investment funds into the southern Chinese boomtown of Shenzhen in the January-May period of 1997, the Shenzhen-based Securities Times said on Friday.
Shenzhen received $1.144 billion in actual foreign investment in the period, up 57.6 percent from the same period in 1996, the newspaper said.
Between 1979 and 1996, Hong Kong-based investors channelled a total of $7.638 billion into more than 16,000 projects in Shenzhen, it said without giving further details.
